recentItems.title: Israel Elections: Arabs To Kick Out Netanyahu With This Bold Eisenkot Move? Next PM Will Be…| WATCH
recentItems.description:
Description: The leader of an Arab-led party that secured record turnout said that he was willing to join forces with Jewish-led parties to oust Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. Ahmed Tibi said that the elections showed that Netanyahu did not command support from a majority of Israelis. Tibi said that his party, Ta’al, and the two others that make up the Joint Arab List were under no illusions that an Eisenkot-led government would bring peace or a two-state solution in Israel and the Palestinian territories.
